name: quran-epub-builder
description: Builds two polished Mushaf-style EPUB 3 files (Arabic-only Uthmani, and Indonesian Kemenag) from the quran.com API v4.

scripts.build:clara-image: python build-clara-image-epub.py "dist/Al-Quran/pdf/Kobo-Clara/Al-Quran Kobo Clara.pdf" "dist/Al-Quran/epub/Kobo-Clara/Al-Quran Kobo Clara (Gambar).epub" "Al-Qur'an al-Karim" 0 1072 4
scripts.build:clara: npm run build:clara-pdf && npm run build:clara-image
scripts.build:clara-text: python build-kobo-clara-epub.py "dist/Al-Quran/epub/Universal/Al-Quran (IndoPak Format).epub" "dist/Al-Quran/epub/Kobo-Clara/Al-Quran Kobo Clara (Teks).epub" --swap ScheherazadeNew-Regular.ttf assets/fonts/LPMQ-IsepMisbah.ttf --x4-style --ayah-ornament
scripts.build:clara-text-amiri: python build-kobo-clara-epub.py "dist/Al-Quran/epub/Universal/Al-Quran (IndoPak Format).epub" "dist/Al-Quran/epub/Kobo-Clara/Al-Quran Kobo Clara (Teks Amiri).epub" --swap ScheherazadeNew-Regular.ttf assets/fonts/AmiriQuran-Regular.ttf --x4-style --canonical-marks
